{{Quote|I am Lieutenant Treshoda. High Command has tasked me to learn how these rebels think. As distasteful as that is.|Tulsar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Treshoda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was tasked by [[Imperial High Command (Sith Empire)|Imperial High Command]] with studying the [[Balmorran resistance]], and dealt with defectors such as [[Gryffin Remus]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Treshoda appears in the mission "The Defector" for players on the Imperial version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

Upon initially accepting the mission, Gryffin Remus refers to Treshoda using "he/him" pronouns, and later when attempting to speak with Remus after completing the mission, he uses a "they" pronoun when again referring to Treshoda. It is unknown if this was intentional or a bug in the dialogue.<ref name="TOR" />
